risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and quantified, but includes substantial industry-background and segment-description boilerplate. Key risks include sharp declines in RV wholesale shipments and retail demand, inflation, higher interest rates, dealer inventory financing costs, and judgment-sensitive acquisition valuations. Management presents diversification and possible future rate reductions as mitigating factors, but some outlook statements remain conditional.
